2 up 1 down straight leg calf raise elev:
Steps
1. Stand with the balls of both feet on the edge of a step, heels hanging off and knees straight
2. Rise up onto your toes using both legs
3. Shift your weight onto one leg at the top
4. Slowly lower that heel below the step over 3 to 5 seconds
5. Put the other foot back down and repeat

Tip
Hold a rail or wall for balance so the calf does the work, not your balance.
a-triple switch:
Steps
1. Stand tall in the A position: one knee driven up to hip height, toes pulled up, standing on the ball of the other foot
2. Rapidly switch legs three times, driving the down leg into the ground each time
3. Finish on the third switch and hold the A position for a moment
4. Reset and repeat, starting on the other leg

Tip
Stay tall with your hips high. The ground contacts should be quick and quiet.
band anchored single arm chest press:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at chest height behind you and hold the handle in one hand
2. Take a split stance with the opposite foot forward and brace your trunk
3. Press the band straight forward until your arm is long
4. Control the band back until your hand is beside your chest

Tip
Don't let the band twist your torso. Keep your hips and shoulders square.
band anchored single arm tricep pushdown:
Steps
1. Anchor a band high and hold it in one hand with your elbow bent and tucked at your side
2. Keep your upper arm still and push your hand down until your elbow is straight
3. Squeeze the back of the arm at the bottom
4. Let your hand come back up slowly to about chest height

Tip
Only your forearm should move.
band external shoulder rotation:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand furthest from the anchor
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees, forearm across your stomach
3. Rotate your forearm out away from your body, keeping the elbow pinned
4. Slowly return to the start

Tip
A rolled towel between your elbow and ribs helps keep the elbow in place.
band internal shoulder rotation:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand closest to the anchor
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees, forearm pointing out
3. Rotate your forearm in across your stomach, keeping the elbow pinned
4. Slowly return to the start

Tip
Move from the shoulder joint. Your wrist stays straight.
band lateral neck iso hold:
Steps
1. Loop a band around the side of your head just above the ear, anchored to one side
2. Step away from the anchor until you feel tension
3. Keep your head level and upright, resisting the band pulling it sideways
4. Hold for the set time, then turn around and do the other side

Tip
Breathe normally throughout. Stop if you get any pins and needles.
band neck nod:
Steps
1. Loop a light band around the back of your head and anchor it in front of you
2. Sit or stand tall with your chin level
3. Slowly nod your chin down towards your chest against the band
4. Return to level with control

Tip
Small range, slow tempo. This is about control, not load.
band neck protraction + lateral flexion:
Steps
1. Loop a band around your head, anchored behind you
2. Glide your chin forward (protraction) against the band
3. Then tilt your ear towards your shoulder
4. Return to centre and pull your chin back to neutral

Tip
Move slowly and keep your shoulders still.
band neck retraction + lateral flexion:
Steps
1. Loop a band around your forehead, anchored in front of you
2. Draw your chin straight back (a double chin) against the band
3. Then tilt your ear towards your shoulder
4. Return to centre and let your chin glide forward to neutral

Tip
Keep your eyes level and your shoulders relaxed.
band protraction neck iso hold:
Steps
1. Place the band behind your head and anchor it behind you
2. Walk forward until there's tension, keeping a slight chin tuck
3. Hold your head still against the band for the set time
4. Step back to release

Tip
The more you lean forward, the harder it gets. Keep breathing.
band retraction neck iso hold:
Steps
1. Place the band around your forehead, anchored in front of you
2. Walk back until there's tension, keeping your chin level
3. Hold your head still against the band for the set time
4. Step forward to release

Tip
Keep breathing and don't let your head get pulled forward.
band standing row:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at chest height and hold an end in each hand
2. Stand tall with a soft bend in your knees and arms straight
3. Pull your elbows back past your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together
4. Slowly let your arms straighten

Tip
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
band wrist pronation - rack set up:
Steps
1. Anchor a band low on a rack and hold a dowel or handle with the band attached to one side
2. Rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench, elbow at 90 degrees
3. Start palm up and rotate your palm down against the band
4. Slowly rotate back to palm up

Tip
The forearm stays still. Only the hand and wrist rotate.
band wrist supination - rig set up:
Steps
1. Anchor a band low on a rig and hold a dowel or handle with the band attached to one side
2. Rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench, elbow at 90 degrees
3. Start palm down and rotate your palm up against the band
4. Slowly rotate back to palm down

Tip
Keep your elbow tucked and still.
band-resisted quasi-isometric 4-way neck:
Steps
1. Loop a band around your head, anchored to the front
2. Very slowly move your head against the band through a small range, taking 5 or more seconds each way
3. Repeat facing away, then each side, so you train all 4 directions
4. Keep tension on the band the whole time

Tip
Slow is the point. If you can move fast, the band is too light.
banded iso shoulder external rotation:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand furthest from the anchor
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees
3. Rotate your forearm out a little and hold that position against the band
4. Hold for the set time, then switch arms

Tip
Push at a steady effort. Don't let the elbow drift away from your side.
banded neck lateral iso hold - rack:
Steps
1. Loop a band on a rack at head height and around the side of your head above the ear
2. Step away until there's tension, standing side-on
3. Keep your head level and resist the band for the set time
4. Turn around and repeat on the other side

Tip
Breathe normally and keep your shoulders level.
banded neck protraction iso hold - rack:
Steps
1. Loop a band on a rack at head height and around the back of your head
2. Face away from the rack and step forward until there's tension
3. Keep a slight chin tuck and hold your head still for the set time
4. Step back to release

Tip
Lean forward more to make it harder.
banded neck retraction iso hold - rack:
Steps
1. Loop a band on a rack at head height and around your forehead
2. Face the rack and step back until there's tension
3. Keep your chin level and hold your head still for the set time
4. Step forward to release

Tip
Don't let the band pull your chin forward.
banded shoulder external rotation - adbu:
Steps
1. Anchor a band in front of you at shoulder height
2. Lift your arm out to the side so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward
3. Rotate your forearm up until it points to the ceiling
4. Slowly lower back to the start

Tip
Your elbow stays at shoulder height the whole time.
barbell cuban press:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell with a shoulder-width grip, arms hanging
2. Upright row the bar until your elbows are at shoulder height
3. Rotate your forearms up so the bar is in front of your face, elbows still at shoulder height
4. Press the bar overhead
5. Reverse each step slowly to return

Tip
Use a light load. This is a shoulder health drill, not a strength lift.
barbell zercher shrug:
Steps
1. Hold the barbell in the crook of your elbows, close to your body
2. Stand tall with your trunk braced
3. Shrug your shoulders straight up towards your ears
4. Pause, then lower slowly

Tip
Don't roll your shoulders. Straight up, straight down.
barefoot backward cycles:
Steps
1. Stand tall, barefoot, on a soft surface
2. Move backwards with a cycling leg action, reaching each foot back
3. Land on the front of your foot each step
4. Keep your steps light and controlled

Tip
Ease into it. Start with short distances.
barefoot dribble:
Steps
1. Stand tall, barefoot, on a soft surface
2. Take small, rapid steps forward, the ankle of the moving leg stepping over the other ankle
3. Land on the front and middle of the foot each time
4. Keep the foot active, not floppy

Tip
Quick turnover and light contacts.
barefoot in to outs:
Steps
1. Stand tall, barefoot, on a soft surface
2. Move forward, swinging each leg from the inside to the outside as you step
3. Land on the mid to forefoot each time
4. Keep the foot firm and the contacts light

Tip
Feel light and springy, not heavy.
barefoot out to in:
Steps
1. Stand tall, barefoot, on a soft surface
2. Move forward, swinging each leg from the outside to the inside as you step
3. Land on the mid to forefoot each time
4. Keep the foot firm and the contacts light

Tip
Feel light and springy, not heavy.
barefoot reach backs:
Steps
1. Stand tall, barefoot, on a soft surface
2. Walk or jog backwards, reaching each foot slightly behind you
3. Land on the front of your foot each step
4. Keep your chest up and your steps controlled

Tip
Short, smooth steps. Don't lean back.
barefoot single leg sweeps eyes closed:
Steps
1. Stand barefoot on one leg near a wall or rail
2. Close your eyes
3. Slowly sweep the other leg forward, out to the side and back, keeping your balance
4. Repeat, then switch legs

Tip
Open your eyes and grab support if you start to lose balance.
behind the neck lat pulldown:
Steps
1. Sit at the pulldown with a wide grip and your thighs under the pad
2. Lean very slightly forward and pull the bar down behind your head towards the top of your neck
3. Keep your elbows pointing down, not back
4. Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight

Tip
Only go as low as your shoulders comfortably allow. Skip it if it pinches.
bench tricep dip:
Steps
1. Sit on the edge of a bench, hands beside your hips, fingers forward
2. Slide your hips off the bench with your legs out in front
3. Bend your elbows to lower your body until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor
4. Press back up until your arms are straight

Tip
Keep your hips close to the bench and your shoulders down.
bent knee loaded toe walks:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells or kettlebells at your sides
2. Rise onto your toes with a slight bend in your knees
3. Walk forward with short steps, staying high on your toes
4. Keep the knees bent and the heels up the whole time

Tip
If your heels drop, the set is over.
bent knee toe walks:
Steps
1. Rise onto your toes with a slight bend in your knees
2. Walk forward with short steps, staying high on your toes
3. Keep the knees bent and the heels up the whole time
4. Stand tall with your trunk braced

Tip
If your heels drop, the set is over.
bird dog:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips
2. Brace your trunk so your back is flat
3. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your body
4. Pause, return under control, then switch sides

Tip
Imagine balancing a glass of water on your lower back.
body weight bent knee calf raises:
Steps
1. Stand on the edge of a step or flat ground with your knees bent slightly
2. Keep that knee bend as you rise as high as you can onto your toes
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
This targets the soleus. Don't straighten your knees as you rise.
body weight calf raise:
Steps
1. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, holding something for balance
2. Rise as high as you can onto the balls of your feet
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower your heels slowly to the ground

Tip
Push through your big toe. Don't roll to the outside of your foot.
body weight forward lunge:
Steps
1. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart
2. Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees
3. Keep your chest up and your front knee in line with your toes
4. Push through the front foot to step back to the start

Tip
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side.
bodyweight bent knee calf raise:
Steps
1. Stand with your knees bent slightly
2. Keep that knee bend as you rise as high as you can onto your toes
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
This targets the soleus. Don't straighten your knees as you rise.
bodyweight bent knee single leg calf rai:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg with that knee slightly bent, holding something for balance
2. Keep the knee bend as you rise as high as you can onto your toes
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly, then switch legs after the set

Tip
Push through your big toe.
bodyweight deadbug:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your arms pointing to the ceiling and hips and knees at 90 degrees
2. Press your lower back gently into the floor
3. Slowly lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg towards the floor
4. Return to the start and switch sides

Tip
If your lower back lifts off the floor, shorten the range.
bodyweight outside leg calf raise:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg, holding something for balance
2. Rise onto your toes, pushing off the outside of your foot
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Push through the outside of your foot the whole way.
bodyweight rear foot elevated squat:
Steps
1. Stand about a stride in front of a bench and rest the top of your back foot on it
2. Lower straight down until your back knee is just above the floor
3. Keep your chest up and front knee tracking over your toes
4. Push through the front foot to stand up

Tip
Most of your weight stays on the front leg.
bodyweight split squat:
Steps
1. Stand in a long split stance, feet hip-width apart
2. Lower straight down until your back knee is just above the floor
3. Keep your chest up and front knee tracking over your toes
4. Push through the front foot to return to the top

Tip
Stay in the split stance for all reps, then switch.
bottoms up kettlebell carry - single arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle, bell pointing up, elbow at 90 degrees
2. Squeeze the handle hard to keep the bell balanced
3. Walk forward with slow, controlled steps
4. Switch arms after the set distance

Tip
Keep your wrist straight and your shoulder down.
cable - bayesian bicep curl:
Steps
1. Set the cable low and face away from it, holding the handle with your arm behind your body
2. Take a step forward so your arm is stretched behind you
3. Curl the handle up towards your shoulder, keeping your elbow behind your torso
4. Slowly lower back to the stretched position

Tip
Can do one side at a time if two cables aren't available.
cable - single arm shoulder extension -:
Steps
1. Set the cable high and hold the handle in one hand with your arm straight
2. Set your shoulder blades back and down
3. Pull your straight arm down and back in an I, then a Y, then a T direction
4. Return slowly after each rep

Tip
Light weight. Lead with the shoulder blade, not the hand.
cable external rotations in genie positi:
Steps
1. Set the cable at shoulder height in front of you
2. Lift your arm so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees, forearm forward
3. Rotate your forearm up until it points to the ceiling
4. Slowly return to the start

Tip
Use a light weight and control both directions.
cable hip adduction:
Steps
1. Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and stand side-on with the strap on the inside leg
2. Hold the machine or a dowel for balance
3. Pull the strapped leg across in front of your standing leg
4. Slowly let it return out to the side

Tip
Stand tall and don't lean as you pull.
cable internal rotation in genie positio:
Steps
1. Set the cable at shoulder height behind you
2. Lift your arm so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees, forearm pointing up
3. Rotate your forearm forward and down until it points forward
4. Control the cable as it returns

Tip
Elbow stays at shoulder height throughout.
cable iso external rotation:
Steps
1. Set the cable at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand furthest from the stack
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees
3. Rotate your forearm out slightly and hold it there against the cable
4. Hold for the set time, then switch arms

Tip
Keep a steady effort and don't let the elbow drift.
cable overhead rope tricep extension - e:
Steps
1. Attach a rope to a cable and face away, holding the rope behind your head
2. Let your elbows point out to the sides
3. Extend your arms forward and up until they're straight
4. Slowly bend your elbows to return

Tip
Keep your ribs down so your back doesn't arch.
cable overhead rope triceps extension -:
Steps
1. Attach a rope or handle low and face away, holding it behind your head in one hand
2. Point your elbow up
3. Straighten your arm overhead
4. Slowly bend the elbow to return, then switch arms

Tip
Keep the upper arm still. Only the forearm moves.
cable rope tricep extension:
Steps
1. Attach a rope to a high cable and hold the ends with your elbows tucked at your sides
2. Push the rope down until your arms are straight, spreading the ends apart at the bottom
3. Squeeze the triceps
4. Let the rope rise slowly to chest height

Tip
Your elbows stay pinned to your sides.
cable shoulder adduction - single arm:
Steps
1. Set the cable high beside you and hold the handle with your arm out to the side
2. Keep your chest up
3. Pull your arm down to your side, palm finishing towards your hip
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your shoulder down away from your ear.
cable shoulder external rotation - abduc:
Steps
1. Set the cable at shoulder height in front of you
2. Lift your arm so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees
3. Rotate your forearm up until it points to the ceiling
4. Slowly lower back to the start

Tip
Keep your elbow fixed and don't bend at the wrist.
cable shoulder internal rotation - abduc:
Steps
1. Set the cable at shoulder height behind you
2. Lift your arm so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees, forearm up
3. Rotate your forearm forward and down
4. Slowly return to the start

Tip
Keep your elbow fixed and don't bend at the wrist.
cable shoulder iso internal rotation:
Steps
1. Set the cable at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand closest to the stack
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees
3. Pull your forearm in slightly and hold against the cable
4. Hold for the set time, then switch arms

Tip
Steady effort, elbow pinned.
cable straight bar tricep pushdown:
Steps
1. Attach a straight bar to a high cable and grip it overhand, shoulder-width
2. Tuck your elbows at your sides
3. Push the bar down until your arms are straight
4. Let it rise slowly to chest height

Tip
Don't lean over the bar. Stand tall.
cable tricep rope pushdown iso hold:
Steps
1. Attach a rope to a high cable and push it down until your arms are straight
2. Spread the rope ends apart at the bottom
3. Hold that position with the triceps squeezed for the set time
4. Let the rope rise slowly to finish

Tip
Keep tension in the triceps the whole hold.
cable y raise:
Steps
1. Set the cable low and stand side-on or facing it, holding the handle
2. Keep your arm straight with a thumb-up grip
3. Raise your arm up and out into a Y overhead
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your ribs down as you lift.
calf raise:
Steps
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding something for balance if needed
2. Rise as high as you can onto the balls of your feet
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Push through the big toe.
cat to cow:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips
2. Round your back up towards the ceiling, tucking your chin and tailbone (cat)
3. Slowly arch your back, lifting your chest and tailbone (cow)
4. Move slowly between the two with your breath

Tip
Move through the whole spine, one segment at a time.
chest supported db front raise:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on an incline bench holding dumbbells, arms hanging
2. Keep your arms straight with a slight bend in the elbow
3. Raise the dumbbells forward to about shoulder height
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your chest on the pad so you can't swing.
child's pose:
Steps
1. Kneel with your big toes together and knees apart
2. Sit your hips back towards your heels
3. Reach your arms forward and rest your forehead on the floor
4. Breathe slowly and hold

Tip
Let your back relax and sink with each breath out.
cycling:
Steps
1. Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke
2. Start at an easy pace to warm up
3. Ride at the pace or intensity prescribed
4. Ease off for the last minute to cool down

Tip
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your cadence smooth.
dead ball over the shoulder:
Steps
1. Stand with the ball between your feet
2. Hinge and squat down to grab it with both hands
3. Drive through your legs and hips to lift it and throw it over one shoulder
4. Turn around, reset and repeat, alternating shoulders

Tip
Use your legs and hips, not your back.
decline tricep extensions:
Steps
1. Lie on a decline bench holding a bar or dumbbells above your chest
2. Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weight towards your forehead
3. Extend your arms back to straight
4. Repeat with control

Tip
Keep your elbows pointing up, not flaring out.
donkey kick:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees
2. Keep one knee bent at 90 degrees and lift it up behind you, sole of the foot to the ceiling
3. Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back
4. Lower slowly and repeat, then switch legs

Tip
Brace your trunk so the movement comes from the hip.
double leg hamstring iso hold on bench -:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your heels on the edge of a bench, legs straight
2. Drive your heels into the bench and lift your hips
3. Hold a straight line from your heels to your shoulders
4. Hold for the set time, then lower

Tip
Squeeze your glutes and keep pushing through your heels.
dowel radial deviation:
Steps
1. Stand holding a dowel near one end, arm at your side, dowel pointing forward
2. Keep your arm still and tilt the dowel up by bending at the wrist (thumb side)
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Hold further from the end to make it harder, closer to the middle to make it easier.
dowel ulnar deviation:
Steps
1. Stand holding a dowel near one end, arm at your side, dowel pointing behind you
2. Keep your arm still and tilt the dowel up behind you by bending at the wrist (little finger side)
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Hold further from the end to make it harder, closer to the middle to make it easier.
dowel wrist supination & pronation:
Steps
1. Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, holding a dowel upright near one end
2. Slowly rotate your palm down so the dowel moves to one side
3. Rotate back past upright until your palm faces up
4. Repeat with control

Tip
Keep your forearm still. Change your grip to adjust the difficulty.
downward dog w/ alternating toe touch:
Steps
1. Start in a push-up position
2. Push your hips up and back into a downward dog, reaching your body away from the floor
3. Reach one hand back to touch the opposite foot or shin
4. Return the hand and repeat on the other side

Tip
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
dumbbell alternating cross body hammer c:
Steps
1. Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in
2. Curl one dumbbell up across your body towards the opposite shoulder
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat with the other arm

Tip
Keep your elbow by your side and don't swing.
dumbbell alternating hammer curl:
Steps
1. Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in
2. Curl one dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping the palm facing in
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat with the other arm

Tip
Keep your elbows by your sides.
dumbbell alternating iso lateral raise:
Steps
1. Raise both dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height
2. Hold one arm there while you lower and raise the other
3. Switch so the other arm holds while the first one works
4. Keep alternating for the set reps

Tip
Lead with your elbows and keep your shoulders down.
dumbbell bent over shrug:
Steps
1. Hinge forward with a flat back, holding dumbbells with arms hanging
2. Pull your shoulder blades back and together without bending your elbows
3. Pause, then let them spread apart
4. Repeat

Tip
Small movement. Arms stay straight.
dumbbell bicep curl:
Steps
1. Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward
2. Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders
3. Squeeze at the top
4. Lower slowly until your arms are straight

Tip
Keep your elbows by your sides and don't swing.
dumbbell bicep curl - drop catch:
Steps
1. Curl a dumbbell to the top position
2. Let go of it briefly so it drops
3. Quickly catch it partway down and stop it
4. Curl it back up and repeat

Tip
Use a light weight. The goal is a fast catch.
dumbbell bicep curl to overhead triceps:
Steps
1. Stand holding dumbbells at your sides
2. Curl them up to your shoulders
3. Press them overhead, then lower them behind your head by bending your elbows
4. Extend back up, bring them to your shoulders and lower to your sides

Tip
Brace your trunk so your back doesn't arch overhead.
dumbbell bulgarian split squat:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand about a stride in front of a bench
2. Rest the top of your back foot on the bench
3. Lower until your back knee is just above the floor, front knee tracking over your toes
4. Push through the front foot to stand up

Tip
Most of your weight stays on the front leg.
dumbbell drop landing:
Steps
1. Stand tall holding light dumbbells at your sides
2. Rise onto your toes, then quickly drop your hips into a quarter squat
3. Stick the landing and stop dead
4. Stand up and reset

Tip
Don't let your body keep sinking after you land.
dumbbell forward lunge:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides
2. Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees
3. Keep your chest up and front knee in line with your toes
4. Push through the front foot to step back

Tip
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side.
dumbbell genie external rotation - incli:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a light dumbbell
2. Lift your elbow to shoulder height with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, forearm hanging
3. Rotate your forearm up until it's level with your body
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Rotate from the shoulder joint. The elbow stays put.
dumbbell goblet carry:
Steps
1. Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands
2. Stand tall with your elbows tucked
3. Walk with controlled steps for the set distance or time
4. Keep the weight close and your trunk braced

Tip
Don't lean back.
dumbbell hammer to supinated curl:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in
2. Curl up with palms in
3. At the top, rotate your palms to face you
4. Lower slowly, rotating back to palms in

Tip
Elbows stay by your sides.
dumbbell incline bicep curl - externally:
Steps
1. Sit back on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging, palms forward
2. Turn your arms out slightly so your palms face a little outwards
3. Curl the dumbbells up, keeping your elbows behind your body
4. Lower slowly to full stretch

Tip
Don't let your shoulders roll forward.
dumbbell lateral raise:
Steps
1. Stand holding dumbbells at your sides
2. With a slight bend in your elbows, raise them out to the sides to shoulder height
3. Pause briefly
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Lead with your elbows and keep your shoulders down.
dumbbell pinch grip hold:
Steps
1. Hold a dumbbell by the end of the head with your fingertips and thumb
2. Stand tall with your arm by your side
3. Hold for the set time
4. Switch hands

Tip
Squeeze as hard as you can.
dumbbell reverse curl:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms facing back
2. Curl them up towards your shoulders, keeping your palms facing down
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your wrists straight.
dumbbell reverse lunge:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides
2. Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees
3. Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes
4. Push through the front foot to step back to the start

Tip
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side.
dumbbell rolling tricep extension on ben:
Steps
1. Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in
2. Bend your elbows and let the dumbbells roll back beside your head, elbows drifting back
3. Bring your elbows forward and press the dumbbells back over your chest
4. Repeat

Tip
Control the lowering.
dumbbell scaption raise:
Steps
1. Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, thumbs pointing up
2. Raise your arms at about 30 degrees in front of your sides (a shallow V)
3. Lift to shoulder height
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
dumbbell seated front raise:
Steps
1. Sit tall on a bench holding dumbbells at your sides
2. Keep your arms straight with a slight bend in your elbows
3. Raise the dumbbells forward to shoulder height
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Don't lean back.
dumbbell single arm bicep curl:
Steps
1. Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side, palm forward
2. Curl it up towards your shoulder
3. Squeeze at the top
4. Lower slowly, then switch arms after the set

Tip
Elbow stays by your side.
dumbbell single arm shrug:
Steps
1. Hold a dumbbell in one hand at your side
2. Shrug that shoulder straight up towards your ear
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly, then switch sides after the set

Tip
Don't lean to the other side.
dumbbell single arm tricep kickback:
Steps
1. Hinge forward with one hand on a bench and a dumbbell in the other hand
2. Pull your elbow up beside your ribs and keep it there
3. Straighten your arm back until it's in line with your body
4. Bend the elbow slowly to return

Tip
Only your forearm moves.
dumbbell skull crusher:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in
2. Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head
3. Extend your arms back to straight
4. Repeat

Tip
Elbows point to the ceiling the whole time.
dumbbell spider curl:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on an incline bench with your arms hanging straight down holding dumbbells
2. Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders
3. Squeeze at the top
4. Lower slowly to straight arms

Tip
Keep your upper arms vertical.
dumbbell standing shoulder press:
Steps
1. Stand tall holding dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward or facing in
2. Brace your trunk and squeeze your glutes
3. Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight
4. Lower slowly to your shoulders

Tip
Don't arch your lower back.
dumbbell step up:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides and place one foot fully on a box or bench
2. Drive through that foot to stand up on the box
3. Bring the other foot up, then step down with control
4. Repeat

Tip
Push through the top leg. Don't push off the bottom foot.
dumbbell strict curl:
Steps
1. Stand with your back against a wall or post, holding dumbbells at your sides
2. Curl them up towards your shoulders
3. Squeeze at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
The wall stops you swinging. Keep your back on it.
dumbbell sumo squat:
Steps
1. Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, holding one dumbbell vertically between your legs
2. Sit your hips down, keeping your chest up
3. Push your knees out over your toes
4. Drive up through your heels to stand

Tip
Keep your back flat.
dumbbell tall landing - single leg:
Steps
1. Stand tall on one leg holding light dumbbells
2. Rise onto your toes, then drop quickly into a small knee bend
3. Stick the landing and hold it still
4. Reset and repeat, then switch legs

Tip
Land quietly with your knee over your toes.
dumbbell wrist extension:
Steps
1. Sit with your forearm on your thigh or a bench, palm facing down, wrist over the edge
2. Hold a light dumbbell
3. Lift the back of your hand up towards the ceiling
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Only the wrist moves.
dumbbell wrist flexion:
Steps
1. Sit with your forearm on your thigh or a bench, palm facing up, wrist over the edge
2. Hold a light dumbbell
3. Curl your wrist up
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Only the wrist moves.
elbow plank:
Steps
1. Lie face down and place your elbows under your shoulders
2. Lift your body so you're on your forearms and toes
3. Hold a straight line from your head to your heels
4. Hold for the set time

Tip
Squeeze your glutes and don't let your hips sag.
elbow side plank:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked
2. Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line
3. Hold for the set time
4. Switch sides

Tip
Don't let your hips drop or rotate.
elbow tap:
Steps
1. Start in a push-up position with your hands under your shoulders
2. Separate your feet a little for balance
3. Lift one hand and tap the opposite elbow
4. Put it down and repeat on the other side

Tip
Keep a flat back and your hips still.
elbows out triceps extension:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench holding dumbbells at your chest, elbows pointing out to the sides
2. Keep your elbows fixed and press the dumbbells up and out until your arms are straight
3. Lower slowly back to your chest
4. Repeat

Tip
Elbows stay in the same spot as you press.
eye closed \"yes\":
Steps
1. Stand near something you can grab for support
2. Close your eyes
3. Slowly nod your head up and down as if saying yes
4. Keep your balance for the set reps or time

Tip
If you lose balance, open your eyes and grab on.
ez bar bicep curl:
Steps
1. Stand tall holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip on the angled part
2. Curl the bar up towards your shoulders
3. Squeeze at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Elbows by your sides. Don't swing.
ez bar reverse curl:
Steps
1. Stand tall holding an EZ bar with an overhand grip
2. Curl the bar up towards your shoulders, keeping your palms facing down
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your wrists straight.
ez bar strict curl:
Steps
1. Stand with your back against a wall or post holding an EZ bar underhand
2. Curl the bar up towards your shoulders
3. Squeeze at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
The wall stops you swinging.
farmer carry:
Steps
1. Pick up a heavy weight in each hand from the floor with a flat back
2. Stand tall with your shoulders down
3. Walk with short, controlled steps for the set distance or time
4. Put the weights down with a flat back

Tip
Don't lean or let the weights swing.
fire hydrant:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees
2. Keep one knee bent and lift it out to the side
3. Raise it as high as you can without rotating your trunk
4. Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides

Tip
Keep your back flat.
fire hydrant hip circle:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees
2. Lift one knee out to the side
3. Draw a big slow circle with the knee, forward, out, back and down
4. Repeat in the other direction, then switch sides

Tip
Keep your trunk still.
foam roller adductor:
Steps
1. Lie face down and place the roller under the inside of one thigh, leg bent out to the side
2. Support yourself on your forearms
3. Roll slowly from just above the knee towards the groin
4. Pause on tight spots for a few breaths

Tip
Slow rolls. Don't rush.
foam roller back:
Steps
1. Sit in front of the roller and lie back so it's across your mid-back
2. Support your head with your hands and lift your hips
3. Roll slowly between your lower ribs and shoulder blades
4. Pause on tight spots

Tip
Don't roll your lower back.
foam roller calf:
Steps
1. Sit with the roller under one calf and your hands behind you
2. Cross the other leg on top for more pressure
3. Roll slowly from the ankle to below the knee
4. Turn the foot in and out to cover the sides

Tip
Pause on tight spots for a few breaths.
foam roller calf smash:
Steps
1. Sit with the roller under one calf and the other leg crossed on top
2. Find a tight spot and hold pressure there
3. Slowly point and flex your foot while holding pressure
4. Move to the next spot

Tip
Breathe slowly. Keep it uncomfortable, not painful.
foam roller chest:
Steps
1. Lie face down with the roller under one side of your chest near the shoulder, arm out to the side
2. Roll slowly across the chest muscle
3. Pause on tight spots
4. Switch sides

Tip
Small, slow movements.
foam roller glute:
Steps
1. Sit on the roller and cross one ankle over the opposite knee
2. Lean towards the crossed leg's side
3. Roll slowly over the glute
4. Switch sides

Tip
Pause on tight spots for a few breaths.
foam roller hamstring:
Steps
1. Sit with the roller under your thighs and your hands behind you
2. Lift your hips and roll from above the knee to below the glutes
3. Cross one leg over the other for more pressure
4. Turn your legs in and out to cover the sides

Tip
Slow rolls.
foam roller hip flexor:
Steps
1. Lie face down with the roller just below the front of your hip bone
2. Support yourself on your forearms
3. Roll slowly over the front of the hip
4. Switch sides

Tip
Small range. Breathe and relax into it.
foam roller lat:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with the roller under your armpit, arm stretched overhead
2. Roll slowly down the side of your back towards your ribs
3. Turn slightly forward and back to cover the muscle
4. Switch sides

Tip
Pause on tight spots.
foam roller quadricep:
Steps
1. Lie face down with the roller under your thighs, supported on your forearms
2. Roll from just above the knee to the hip
3. Shift your weight to one leg for more pressure
4. Turn your legs in and out to cover the sides

Tip
Keep your trunk braced so your back doesn't sag.
foam roller shin:
Steps
1. Kneel on all fours with the roller under the front of your shins
2. Support yourself with your hands
3. Roll slowly from the ankle to below the knee
4. Turn slightly to cover the outside of the shin

Tip
Ease off if it's tender.
foam roller tricep:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with the roller under the back of your upper arm, arm overhead
2. Roll from just above the elbow towards the armpit
3. Pause on tight spots
4. Switch arms

Tip
Small, slow movements.
foam roller upper back:
Steps
1. Lie back with the roller across your upper back, hands supporting your head
2. Lift your hips slightly
3. Roll slowly from your mid-back to the top of your shoulder blades
4. Pause and gently extend over the roller at tight spots

Tip
Keep your ribs down.
forward fold stretch:
Steps
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart
2. Hinge at the hips and fold forward, letting your head and arms hang
3. Bend your knees as much as you need
4. Breathe slowly and hold

Tip
Let your neck relax.
forward leg swing:
Steps
1. Stand side-on to a wall with one hand on it for support
2. Swing the outside leg forward and back in a smooth arc
3. Gradually increase the range
4. Switch legs

Tip
Keep your trunk tall. The swing comes from the hip.
full sit up:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat
2. Cross your arms on your chest or lightly touch your head
3. Curl your trunk up until your chest is near your thighs
4. Lower slowly back down

Tip
Don't pull on your neck.
glute bridge:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart
2. Brace your trunk and drive through your heels
3. Lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly

Tip
Don't arch your lower back at the top.
glute-ham raise without equipment:
Steps
1. Kneel on a mat with your feet anchored under something solid or held by a partner
2. Squeeze your glutes and brace your trunk
3. Lower your body forward slowly, keeping a straight line from knees to head
4. Use your hands to catch yourself, then pull back up with your hamstrings

Tip
Don't bend at the hips on the way up.
half kneeling band pallof press:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at chest height beside you and kneel on the knee closest to the anchor
2. Hold the band at your chest with both hands
3. Press your hands straight out, resisting the band pulling you round
4. Bring the hands back to your chest

Tip
Stay tall and don't let your trunk rotate.
half kneeling band shoulder tantrum:
Steps
1. Kneel on one knee holding a band anchored overhead
2. Hold the band with your arm up and bent
3. Perform quick, short downward pulls, like a tantrum
4. Keep your trunk still

Tip
Quick and light. The shoulder does the work.
hammer strength biceps curl:
Steps
1. Set the seat so your elbows line up with the machine's pivot
2. Grip the handles with your arms resting on the pad
3. Curl the handles up towards your shoulders
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your elbows on the pad.
hammer strength biceps curl - single arm:
Steps
1. Set the seat so your elbow lines up with the machine's pivot
2. Grip one handle with your arm on the pad
3. Curl it up towards your shoulder
4. Lower slowly, then switch arms

Tip
Keep your elbow on the pad.
hammer strength select lateral raise:
Steps
1. Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot
2. Place your arms against the pads
3. Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your shoulders down.
hammer strength select triceps extension:
Steps
1. Set the seat so your elbows line up with the pivot
2. Place your upper arms on the pad and grip the handles
3. Extend your arms until they're straight
4. Return slowly

Tip
Only the forearms move.
hammer strength shrug:
Steps
1. Stand in the machine and grip the handles with your arms straight
2. Shrug your shoulders straight up towards your ears
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Don't roll your shoulders.
hammer strength standing calf raise - na:
Steps
1. Stand in the calf raise machine on the balls of your feet
2. Rise up onto your toes
3. Quickly switch your knees forward and back, keeping your heels high
4. Keep switching for the set reps or time

Tip
Don't let your heels collapse. Punch your knees through on each switch.
hamstring kicks:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Kick one leg up in front of you, keeping it straight
3. Reach the opposite hand towards the toes
4. Alternate legs as you walk forward

Tip
Stay tall and kick only as high as you can control.
hang to contact point + hang shrug:
Steps
1. Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a clean grip, slight bend in the knees
2. Slide the bar up your thighs to the hip crease (the contact point) by pushing your hips forward
3. Return to the hang
4. From the hang, extend your hips and shrug the bar up

Tip
Arms stay long. This teaches the bar path and timing.
head harness cable neck extension:
Steps
1. Put on a head harness attached to a low cable
2. Hinge forward with your hands on your knees
3. Lift your head back until it's in line with your spine or slightly beyond
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Light weight, smooth reps.
head harness cable neck flexion:
Steps
1. Put on a head harness attached to a cable behind you
2. Stand or sit tall
3. Bring your chin down towards your chest
4. Return slowly to neutral

Tip
Light weight, smooth reps.
head harness cable neck lateral flexion:
Steps
1. Put on a head harness attached to a cable beside you
2. Stand side-on, tall
3. Tilt your ear away from the cable towards your shoulder
4. Return slowly, then switch sides

Tip
Keep your shoulders level.
head harness neck - 4 direction neck:
Steps
1. Put on a head harness attached to a cable
2. Work each direction in turn: forward, back, and each side
3. Move slowly through a comfortable range
4. Turn your body to face each new direction

Tip
Light weight. Stop if you get any pins and needles.
heidens with med ball:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball at your chest
2. Bound sideways off one leg, landing on the other
3. Stick the landing on one leg before bounding back
4. Repeat side to side

Tip
Land soft with your knee over your toes.
high cable tricep overhead extension - s:
Steps
1. Attach a straight bar to a high cable and face away from it
2. Hold the bar behind your head with your elbows pointing forward
3. Extend your arms forward until they're straight
4. Bend your elbows slowly to return

Tip
Stagger your stance for balance and keep your ribs down.
hip airplane - loaded:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell or kettlebell
2. Hinge forward until your trunk is near level, other leg straight behind you
3. Rotate your hips open towards the ceiling, then close them towards the floor
4. Return to standing, then switch legs

Tip
Hold something for balance if needed. Move slowly.
hollow body hold:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your arms overhead and legs straight
2. Press your lower back into the floor
3. Lift your shoulders, arms and legs off the floor
4. Hold for the set time

Tip
If your back lifts, bend your knees or bring your arms forward.
incline bench dumbbell lateral raise:
Steps
1. Lie on your side on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in the top hand
2. Keep your arm straight with a slight bend in the elbow
3. Raise the dumbbell up and out
4. Lower slowly, then switch sides

Tip
Keep your shoulder down away from your ear.
incline bench garhammer raise:
Steps
1. Lie on an incline bench and hold the top behind your head
2. Pull your knees towards your chest, lifting your hips
3. Control your legs as you lower, trying to keep the hips curled
4. Repeat

Tip
Avoid using momentum.
incline bench prone y raise:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on an incline bench with light dumbbells, thumbs facing up
2. Raise your arms up and out into a Y
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your shoulders away from your ears. No weight to make it easier.
incline bench side lying straight leg hi:
Steps
1. Lie on your side on an incline bench with your bottom leg supported
2. Keep your top leg straight
3. Lift it up and slightly back
4. Lower slowly, then switch sides

Tip
Lead with the heel and don't roll back.
incline bench wty plate raise:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a light plate
2. Lift it in a W (elbows bent), then a T (arms out), then a Y (arms overhead)
3. Return slowly after each shape
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your chest on the pad.
incline bench wty raise:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on an incline bench with light dumbbells
2. Raise your arms in a W (elbows bent), then a T (arms out), then a Y (overhead)
3. Return slowly after each shape
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your shoulders down.
isometric adductor ball squeeze:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and a ball between your knees
2. Squeeze the ball as hard as you can
3. Hold for the set time
4. Relax and repeat

Tip
Keep breathing.
isometric med ball squeeze:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball between your hands or knees
2. Crush the ball as hard as you can
3. Hold for the set time
4. Relax and repeat

Tip
Keep breathing.
jefferson curl:
Steps
1. Stand on a box holding a light weight with straight arms
2. Tuck your chin and roll down one segment of your spine at a time
3. Let the weight lower towards your feet as far as you comfortably can
4. Roll back up one segment at a time

Tip
Start very light. Slow and controlled.
jump rope:
Steps
1. Hold the handles at hip height with your elbows close to your sides
2. Turn the rope with your wrists
3. Jump just high enough to clear the rope, landing on the balls of your feet
4. Keep a steady rhythm

Tip
Small, quick jumps.
keiser split stance push & pull:
Steps
1. Set the handles at chest height and stand in a split stance
2. Push one handle forward while pulling the other back
3. Switch arms quickly
4. Repeat

Tip
Be aggressive with each rep.
keiser standing hip abduction:
Steps
1. Attach the ankle strap to the outside leg and stand side-on
2. Hold a dowel or the machine for balance
3. Lift your leg out to the side
4. Return slowly

Tip
Stand tall and don't lean.
keiser standing hip flexion:
Steps
1. Attach the ankle strap and face away from the machine
2. Hold something for balance
3. Drive your knee up towards your chest
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Stay tall.
keiser standing thoracic rotation with b:
Steps
1. Stand side-on holding the bar attached to the machine
2. Wind up towards the machine as far as you can
3. Rotate through your upper back away from the machine
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your chest up as you rotate.
keiser supine leg adduction:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with the ankle strap on the leg closest to the machine
2. Start with that leg out to the side
3. Pull it across towards the midline
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your hips flat.
keiser tricep extension:
Steps
1. Attach a handle and face the machine
2. Tuck your elbows at your sides
3. Push down until your arms are straight
4. Return slowly

Tip
Only the forearms move.
keiser triceps extension - rope attachme:
Steps
1. Attach a rope and face the machine
2. Tuck your elbows at your sides
3. Push the rope down and spread the ends at the bottom
4. Return slowly

Tip
Only the forearms move.
keiser triceps pushdown - trx attachment:
Steps
1. Attach the TRX handles and face the machine
2. Tuck your elbows at your sides
3. Push down until your arms are straight
4. Return slowly

Tip
Only the forearms move.
kettlebell bottom up carry - double arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell upside down in each hand, elbows at 90 degrees
2. Squeeze the handles to balance the bells
3. Walk slowly for the set distance or time
4. Keep your wrists straight

Tip
Keep your shoulders down.
kettlebell bottom up wiper:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell upside down, elbow at 90 degrees
2. Keep your elbow still and rotate your forearm side to side
3. Keep the bell balanced throughout
4. Repeat for the set reps

Tip
Elbow stays at 90 degrees.
kettlebell farmers carry:
Steps
1. Pick up a kettlebell in each hand with a flat back
2. Stand tall with your shoulders down
3. Walk with short, controlled steps
4. Put the bells down with a flat back

Tip
Don't let the bells swing.
kettlebell grip hold:
Steps
1. Pick up a heavy kettlebell in each hand
2. Stand tall with your arms straight
3. Hold for the set time
4. Put them down with a flat back

Tip
Squeeze the handles hard.
kettlebell hammer curl - double arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell by the horns or handle in each hand, palms facing in
2. Curl them up towards your shoulders
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Elbows by your sides.
kettlebell hammer curl - single arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell in one hand, palm facing in
2. Curl it up towards your shoulder
3. Lower slowly
4. Switch arms after the set

Tip
Elbow by your side.
kettlebell hip flexor iso hold:
Steps
1. Sit or stand with a kettlebell hanging from your foot or resting on your thigh
2. Lift your knee to 90 degrees
3. Hold it there for the set time
4. Lower and switch sides

Tip
Stay tall.
kettlebell hip flexor raise:
Steps
1. Sit or stand with a kettlebell hanging from your foot or resting on your thigh
2. Lift your knee to 90 degrees
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat, then switch sides

Tip
Stay tall.
kettlebell rack + suitcase carry:
Steps
1. Hold one kettlebell in the rack position at your shoulder and another at your side
2. Stand tall with your trunk braced
3. Walk for the set distance or time
4. Switch sides

Tip
Don't sway as you walk.
kettlebell rack carry:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at each shoulder
2. Stand tall with your trunk braced
3. Walk with short, controlled steps
4. Keep your elbows tucked

Tip
Don't lean back.
kettlebell rack carry - single arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder
2. Stand tall with your trunk braced
3. Walk with short, controlled steps
4. Switch sides

Tip
Don't lean to either side.
kettlebell radial deviation:
Steps
1. Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle, arm at your side
2. Tilt your hand up at the wrist (thumb side)
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your arm still.
